preconditions.description: The input contains exactly 5 lines, each representing a blimp registration code.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) <= 11 and all(c.isupper() or c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in line) for line in lines)
preconditions.description: Each registration code is a sequence of at most 11 characters consisting of uppercase letters, digits, or dashes.

postconditions.expression: if not cia_indices: stdout == 'HE GOT AWAY!' else stdout == ' '.join(str(i) for i in cia_indices)
postconditions.description: If no CIA blimps are found, output 'HE GOT AWAY!'; otherwise, output the 1-based indices of lines containing 'FBI' as a space-separated string in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: cia_indices == [i + 1 for i, line in enumerate(lines) if 'FBI' in line]
postconditions.description: The list of CIA blimp indices contains exactly those 1-based row numbers where the registration code includes the substring 'FBI'.
